summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an unofficial English translation of a Midroog (Moody's affiliate) ratings report regarding its upcoming Series G notes (up to 550 million par value) and existing bonds. The filing is a routine credit rating update, not a special situation. It reflects an issuer's ordinary debt issuance and rating action, with no corporate event, M&A, activist campaign, or strategic change. The report assigns A2.il ratings with positive outlook and notes proceeds will refinance debt and fund operations. No special-situation classification applies.
